svg.title: Cold Open system architecture
svg.desc: Mission Control and preview-site visitors talk to one Cloudflare Worker. The Worker serves static assets, forwards the API and WebSocket to the HQ Durable Object, renders preview sites, serves hero images from KV, and verifies Stripe redirects and webhooks. HQ stores businesses and events in SQLite, broadcasts over WebSocket, and runs the agent pipeline Scout, Archivist, Builder, Critic (loop until score 85), Director, Closer, CFO, calling Workers AI, KV, Claude, OpenAI, OpenStreetMap Overpass (with a bundled snapshot fallback), business websites, Higgsfield, Taste Labs and Slack. Interrupted builds resume after a restart.
svg.text: One Worker. One Durable Object. Seven agents. Every external key is optional.
run the whole loop. Keys upgrade it.
